subject.title: Mobile chat: code syntax highlighting and richer markdown rendering

question: Should the remaining Android syntax-highlighting work proceed through the existing in-repo tokenizer PR, be redirected to a different library/design, or be dropped for now?
rationale: The issue’s Apple half is implemented on main, but Android still needs a maintainer-owned rendering approach because the choice affects native UI behavior, performance, proof expectations, and any dependency/license obligations.

options.title: Land the Android PR after review
options.body: Use the existing paired Android PR as the landing path once maintainers accept its tokenizer approach and proof.

options.title: Redirect the Android implementation
options.body: Ask for a different Android highlighter/library or narrower language set before merging any remaining work.

options.title: Drop Android highlighting for now
options.body: Close the remaining scope as not planned if the native app should keep plain monospace code blocks.

recommendation.title: Land the Android PR after review
recommendation.body: Use the existing paired Android PR as the landing path once maintainers accept its tokenizer approach and proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to this issue and authored both the merged Apple implementation and the open Android candidate.
